children: Bitcoin is up 0.5% to $81,568, turning around along with the Nasdaq Composite after tech and AI stocks slumped the prior day. While bitcoin has felt that pressure, the fact that it's managed to stay above the $80,000 mark is a point of optimism for cryptocurrency investors, says James Butterfill of CoinShares in a note. "Bitcoin has remained relatively resilient this week despite another bout of volatility across risk assets." Butterfill says that the fundamentals for bitcoin remain mostly balanced, but "a surprise October hike would likely be more disruptive than a well-signalled December move" from the Federal Reserve. The Fed will decide whether to hike or leave interest rates unchanged in its meeting next week. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
